title: Mixing: Sweet Little Sixteen by John Lennon | 1974
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producer: John Lennon

John Lennon mixed the song ‘Sweet Little Sixteen’ for the Rock ‘N’ Roll album on 13 July 1974.

The backing track had been recorded on 22 October 1973, with Phil Spector producing.

With the mixing complete, Lennon then assembled the musicians for his Walls And Bridges album in Studio C. The rehearsals were recorded, and the songs played were ‘Beef Jerky’, ‘Steel And Glass’, ‘Going Down On Love’, ‘Move Over Ms L’, ‘Surprise, Surprise (Sweet Bird Of Paradox)’, ‘Scared’, ‘Old Dirt Road’, ‘Bless You’, ‘Whatever Gets You Thru The Night’, and ‘Nobody Loves You (When You’re Down And Out)’.
